name: bench-007-actuated-arm-joint-v1
summary: Single actuated NEMA 17 arm joint: a bracket holds the motor by its face; an output arm grips the 5mm shaft (running-fit hub bore + radial M3 set screw) and rotates about the shaft axis (revolute), cantilevered. The motor is a non-printed hardware node. Tier 1 is STATIC: coupling correct + revolute coaxial with the real shaft + per-body shells. Powered sweep (arm vs motor body) is OUT of scope (deferred: needs a motor collision mesh).

components.facts: NEMA 17: 42mm body, 5mm shaft, ~24mm usable length; ports face + shaft coaxial by fact

dimensions.spec: grips the 5mm shaft with a running fit
1x radial M3 set screw into the hub bore
printed parts print flat without support

required_interfaces.must_present: arm hub: 5mm running-fit grip bore + radial M3 set-screw boss, coaxial with the shaft

hard_constraints: each printed body manifold, watertight, single shell
the revolute axis is coaxial with the motor shaft (the actuation axis)
the hub bore grips the 5mm shaft (running fit) with a set-screw boss
printed parts print flat without supports (overhangs <= 45 deg)

OUT OF SCOPE (tier 1): arm-clears-motor-body through the powered sweep -- the revolute is hardware-anchored, so range_of_motion WARNs (no motor mesh to sweep); accepted as a known-deferral, not graded
